items.q: What is M. Mohan Rao's official LIC affiliation?
items.a: M. Mohan Rao is an authorized Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) Agent and Financial Advisor with Agency Code 0195676N, recognized as a Chairman's Club Member for Agents and an MDRT Member.
The advisory office is located on Bye-Pass Road, Hosur - 635109, Tamil Nadu, India. In-person consultations are available by appointment, alongside phone and WhatsApp support.

items.q: Can I enquire about new LIC policies?
items.a: Yes. You can consult on all major LIC plan categories including pure term insurance, endowment savings plans, children's milestone plans, money-back policies, and retirement pension plans.

items.q: How can existing policyholders receive servicing assistance?
items.a: Existing LIC policyholders can receive guidance on premium payment channels, policy revival for lapsed plans, address or phone number updates, nominee changes, and loan against policy procedures.

We assist policyholders and families with compiling the necessary claim documentation (maturity or death claims), completing official forms, and submitting them through the appropriate LIC branch procedures. Final claim underwriting and payouts are made directly by LIC.

All premium payments are made directly to the Life Insurance Corporation of India through its official online portal, authorized merchant points, or branch cash counters. The advisor does not accept cash or personal payments.
